content: Best practices for LLM constraint parsing: (1) Confirmation/preview before committing — show parsed intent as human text, require user confirm/reject; (2) Dual-layer ambiguity: LLM semantic classification first, keyword-rule fallback; (3) Incremental updates preserve existing constraints, only modify what changed; (4) Multi-round interaction: ambiguous input triggers clarification question, not a guess; (5) ID validation: validate entity references against the domain before executing tool calls, feed error back to LLM with 'unknown entity' message so LLM can ask user to clarify; (6) Structured output / JSON schema enforcement reduces hallucinated fields.
